7mate.synopsis: Join Sam Pang, Mick Molloy and Andy Maher as they share a laugh about the world of AFL and catch up with stars of yesteryear and today.

7mate.title: Swamp People
7mate.synopsis: Willie Edwards is back and this year he's striking out on his own. Armed with his trademark treble hook, this solo hunter is blind-sided by the biggest monster he's ever taken on... and it's war.

7mate.title: The Fishing Show
7mate.synopsis: Jason Medcalf catches up with freshwater guru Jason Ehrlich and his son, Blake, as they search for the perfect trifecta: Murray cod, golden perch and Australian bass.

7mate.title: Tackling Australia
7mate.synopsis: Nige and Nicko embark on a cross-country journey in Australia to determine whether the wet or dry season produces better fishing. They build a unique boat and start their adventure from the Daintree River.

7mate.title: NFL
7mate.synopsis: From Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
